notes: Stored-equipment preservation logs (ADR 0015). Recurring checklists run against a TAG during the delivered-but-not-yet-installed window, reusing the compliance-template shape (subject_kind='tag', tag_type null, phase null, recurrence set). Added by their own loader (1789000032) AFTER migration 1789000031_Q opens the weekly/monthly recurrence cadences — kept out of compliance_templates.json because the early loader 1789000009 reads that file before the enum is extended. Two templates, split by cadence rather than branched inside one (flat-template rule): a weekly log (shaft rotation, protection, heaters) and a monthly log (oil, rust, condensate, lubrication, desiccant). Skipped preservation is a common manufacturer warranty-void trigger, so this ledger is the provenance a warranty dispute (ADR 0005) turns on. DOMAIN REVIEW NEEDED: the exact item list, turn counts, and cadence split are the maintainer's / manufacturer's call. Recurring EXECUTION UI is Phase 5 (shared with the compliance logs) and not built yet — this seeds the content now.

items.text: Shaft rotated the specified number of turns to redistribute lubricant and prevent bearing brinelling — record turns
Covers, wrapping, and weather protection intact; equipment on dunnage and off the ground
Space heaters energized where provided (verify power)
No standing water, condensation, or fresh rust observed on a quick visual
Equipment stored per manufacturer's long-term storage requirements (dunnage, covers, indoor/outdoor)
Oil level checked and topped off; condition acceptable (no water/emulsion) — record level/condition
No rust or corrosion on machined/unpainted surfaces; preservative/coating reapplied as needed
Condensate drained from casing / gearbox / oil reservoir
Bearings / lubrication serviced per manufacturer (grease/oil, purge as required)
Desiccant / VCI checked and replaced; enclosure openings resealed and covered
Photo of the stored equipment and its protection this cycle
